title: F5: Usage/recharge, resource & attunement state
description: Durable per-entity usage counters (X/day, recharge X-Y, legendary per-round) with reset events (turn-start d6 recharge, short/long rest, dawn) + attunement slot machine (max 3, no duplicates, ending conditions) + inspiration boolean resource (no-stockpile cap, spend->advantage, gifting). Members: limited-usage, legendary-actions, attunement, gaining-inspiration, using-inspiration (IMPL); clauses: charges (live expenditure/recharge), conflict (charmed duration, repeat-on-damage, 1/dawn reset). Source: docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-8-execution-boundary-classification.md §4.
notes:
2026-07-10 design (F5): migration 0007 adds entity_usage_counter (per-owner counters: perDay->dawn reset, recharge d6 min, short/long-rest recharge, item charges w/ recharge formula), attunement table (max3/no-dup/one-creature-per-item/death auto-end), character.inspiration bool, and legendary_actions_used/allowance columns on combat_turn_budget. State: state/usageCounters.ts, state/attunement.ts, state/inspiration.ts; legendary economy inside actionEconomy.ts (spend on others' turns, cost from usage.legendaryActionCost, allowance parsed from legendaryActions.description prose, regain at own turn start via beginTurn reset, refused while surprised). Combatant economies derived structurally from creature record (traits/actions/reactions/legendary entries + innate spellcasting per-day groups incl. shared non-each groups); characters/items use validated explicit registration on first spend (maxUses+reset args). Recharge rolls follow record_death_save pattern: model rolls via roll tool, passes natural result. reset_usage(event) is the engine primitive F7 will orchestrate. Tools: spend_usage, restore_usage, reset_usage, attune_item, end_attunement, award_inspiration, use_inspiration + spend_turn_resource legendary_action resource. Dispositions: limited-usage/legendary-actions/attunement/gaining-inspiration -> implemented; using-inspiration -> partial (advantage grammar -> F1); charges/conflict/innate-spellcasting notes updated.
